name: Bupropion and alcohol risk
actions: Assess the pattern and amount of alcohol use before interpreting the risk.
Avoid abrupt alcohol discontinuation in a person with regular or heavy alcohol use without appropriate clinical guidance.
Minimize or avoid alcohol during bupropion treatment.
Review additional seizure-risk factors and other medications that may lower seizure threshold.

rationale: Abrupt discontinuation of alcohol is a contraindicated clinical situation during bupropion treatment because seizure risk may increase.
Bupropion labeling advises minimizing or avoiding alcohol during treatment.

explanation_template: {A_name} with {B_name} requires alcohol-use context. Bupropion has dose-related seizure risk, abrupt alcohol discontinuation can further increase seizure risk, and alcohol use during treatment should be minimized or avoided (educational).

references.citation: Bupropion hydrochloride prescribing information: Contraindications (4), Seizure (5.3), and Use with Alcohol (7.5).
